'''2010 US West Nationals''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 5–6 June 2010, using the [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]] pool. The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDFs ([[:File:2010 US West Nationals Day 1.pdf]], [[:File:2010 US West Nationals Day 2.pdf]]).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' 5–6 June 2010
* '''Winner:''' —
